title: Surface thermal response
source_title: THEMIS-derived Thermal Inertia of Jezero Crater, Mars
observation_time: Multi-image nighttime mosaic; individual acquisition dates are not supplied in the GeoTIFF. Not current conditions.
kind: Published derived thermal property; not temperature or atmospheric weather
source_crs_wkt: PROJCRS["SimpleCylindrical Mars",BASEGEOGCRS["GCS_Mars",DATUM["D_Mars",ELLIPSOID["Mars",3396190,0,LENGTHUNIT["metre",1,ID["EPSG",9001]]]],PRIMEM["Reference_Meridian",0,ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433,ID["EPSG",9122]]]],CONVERSION["unnamed",METHOD["Equidistant Cylindrical (Spherical)",ID["EPSG",1029]],PARAMETER["Latitude of 1st standard parallel",0,ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433],ID["EPSG",8823]],PARAMETER["Longitude of natural origin",0,ANGLEUNIT["degree",0.0174532925199433],ID["EPSG",8802]],PARAMETER["False easting",0,LENGTHUNIT["metre",1],ID["EPSG",8806]],PARAMETER["False northing",0,LENGTHUNIT["metre",1],ID["EPSG",8807]]],CS[Cartesian,2],AXIS["easting",east,ORDER[1],LENGTHUNIT["metre",1,ID["EPSG",9001]]],AXIS["northing",north,ORDER[2],LENGTHUNIT["metre",1,ID["EPSG",9001]]]]
method: Native source crop; no value interpolation, resampling or artificial 20 m detail. Image extent uses verified same-sphere equirectangular transform and is clipped visually to the pilot.
limits: Thermal inertia describes resistance to heating/cooling. It is not air/surface temperature, live weather, dust storm probability or radiation. Mosaic blending, thermal-model assumptions and albedo influence apply; source reports inter-image offsets up to approximately 20 thermal-inertia units, not a complete uncertainty bound.
